title: Spek's Vanilla QOL
description: Upgrade your vanilla experience without altering the base game. Works on servers!
body:
Spek's Vanilla QOL has everything you need for an enhancend Vanilla experience. It provides quality of life features (inventory tweaks, or xaeros (mini)map), combined with visual and auditory enhancements (animations), rounded up with every mod you need to increase the overall performance of Minecraft.

This modpack is for you, if you:
- plan to play vanilla anyways
- want to hop right into playing without configuring every mod yourself
- like subtle (visual and auditory) improvements to the game, that make go from a 10/10 to a 11/10
- don't want to update your mods manually
